description: Registre public des gares routières is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autorité de régulation des transports (anciennement Arafer). The register of bus stations and stop facilities is published and kept up to date by the Transport Regulatory Authority (formerly Arafer) in accordance with the provisions of Article L.3114-10 of the Transport Code. Coverage: Autorité de régulation des transports (anciennement Arafer). The portal shows the English title as "Public register of bus stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autorité de régulation des transports (anciennement Arafer). Its keywords include transport-routier-de-voyageurs, gare-routiere, autorite-de-regulation-des-transports, slo, services-librement-organises, autocar. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2020-08-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
